questions.question:

questions.question:
Study the graph which shows daily wages (in Rs.) with a number of workers and answer the question that follows.

If the ratio of the total number of workers whose daily wages are less than Rs. 450 to the total number of workers whose daily wages are Rs. 600 or above is a : b, then what is the difference between b and a?
questions.solution:
**Calculation:**

No. of workers whose daily wages are less than 450 = 30

No. of workers whose daily wages are more than 600 = 90

So, the required ratio = 1 : 3 = a : b

⇒ b - a = 3 - 1 = 2 units

**∴ The required answer is 2**

questions.question: If 7 sin² θ + 3 cos² θ = 4, 0°
questions.solution:
**Given:**

7sin²θ + 3cos²θ = 4

**Concept used:**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/d34e7f08076704e6d4c0e353b906d7f45a72f86a8dd5a45bcc9b6063cfe832ed.png] 

**Calculation:**

7sin²θ + 3cos²θ = 4

⇒ 7sin²θ + 3(1 - sin²θ) = 4

⇒ 7sin²θ + 3 - 3sin²θ = 4

⇒ 4sin²θ = 1

⇒ sin²θ = 1/4

⇒ sinθ = 1/2

⇒ θ = 30°

**∴**** The value of θ is 30°**

questions.question: The successive discounts 18%, 10% and 15% are equivalent to a single discount of:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Discounts are 18%, 10% and 15%

**Concept used:**

If the first discount is x% and 2nd discount is y% then Successive Discount Formula –

**Total discount = ( x + y – xy /100)%**

**Calculation:**

18 + 10 - [(18)(10)]/100

⇒ 28 - 1.8

⇒ 26.2

Now, adding 15% discount,

26.2 + 15 - [(26.2)(15)/100]

⇒ 41.2 - 3.93

⇒ 37.27

**∴**** Required answer is 37.27%**

questions.question: In ΔABC, the length of BC is less than twice the length of AB by 2 cm. The length of AC exceeds the length of AB by 6 cm. The perimeter is 60 cm. The length (in cm) of the largest side of the triangle ABC is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

The perimeter of Δ ABC = 60 cm.

**Calculation:**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/e13764ca99ba0ed307ce5d1fe5e4d013aef1f513a52c39d404f7bcf07b978f22.png] **

Let the length of AB be x cm

So, the length of BC = (2x - 2) cm and the length of AC = (x + 6) cm

The perimeter of Δ ABC = 60 cm.

⇒ x + 2x - 2 + x + 6 = 60

⇒ 4x + 4 = 60

⇒ 4x = 56

⇒ x = 14

The lengths of the sides of the triangle are:

AB = 14 cm

BC = (2x - 2) cm = 26 cm

AC = (x + 6) = 20 cm

**∴ The length of the largest side of the triangle is 26 cm.**

questions.question: A bought an article for Rs. 4,800 and sold it at a loss of 30%. With this amount, he bought another article and sold it at a gain of 60%. What was his overall gain/loss?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Cost price of the article = Rs. 4800

Loss % = 30

Profit % = 60

**Concept used:**

SP = CP + CP × profit%

SP = CP – CP × loss%

**Calculation:**

SP of the article = 4800 × 7/10

⇒ 3360

SP of the new article = 3360 × 8/5

⇒ 5376

Profit = 5376 – 4800 = 576

Profit % = (576/4800) × 100

⇒ 12%

**∴ Required answer is 12% gain** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**- 30 + 60 + [(-30)(60)/100]

⇒ + 30 – 18

⇒ + 12

**∴**** Required answer is 12% gain**

questions.question: A can do 60% of a work in 18 days, while B can do 40% of the same work in 10 days. Both work together for 10 days only. C completed the remaining work in 4 days. In how many days will C complete the same work?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A can do 60% in 18 days

B can do 40% in 10 days

**Concept used:**

Total work = LCM of time taken by the workers

Efficiency = Total work/Time taken by the worker

**Calculation:**

A can do 60% in 18 days

A can do 100% in 30 days

B can do 40% in 10 days

B can do 100% in 25 days

questions.question: If a nine-digit number 489x6378y is divisible by 72, then the value of sqrt{8x+6y} will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

489x6378y is divisible by 72

**Concept used:**

If the sum of digits of the number is divisible by 9, then the number itself is divisible by 9

If the last three digits of a number are divisible by 8, then the number is completely divisible by 8

**Calculation:**

72 = 8 × 9

⇒ 78y should be divisible by 8

So, y = 4

⇒ 489x63784 is divisible by 9

So,

⇒ 4 + 8 + 9 + x + 6 + 3 + 7 + 8 + 4 = 49 + x

⇒ x = 5

So,

√(8x + 6y) = √64

⇒ 8

**∴**** The required answer is 8**

questions.question: What will be the compound interest (in Rs.) on a sum of Rs. 7,200 for 18 months at a rate of 20% per annum, if the interest is compounded half-yearly (nearest to an integer)?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Principal = Rs. 7200

Rate of interest = 20%

**Concept used:**

In case of half yearly

Amount = P(1 + (r/2)/100)ⁿ

Interest = Amount - Principal

P = Principal

r = rate

n = time

**Calculation:**

Half yearly interest = 20/2 = 10%

Amount = 7200(1 + 10/100)³

⇒ 7200 × 11/10 × 11/10 × 11/10

⇒ 9583.2

Interest = 9583.2 - 7200 = 2383.2 ≈ 2383

questions.question: A train travels at a speed of 66 km/h and halts at five junctions for a certain time. It covers a distance of 1485 km in one day. For how long (in minutes) does the train stop at each junction, if it halts for the same period of time at all the junctions?
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Speed of the train = 66 km/h

**Concept used:**

Distance = Speed × time

**Calculation:**

Without stoppage train moves 66 × 24 = 1584 kms

For stoppage it is moving 1584 – 1485 = 99 km less

Time takes to cover 99 km by the train = 99/66 = 1.5 hours or 90 min

So, duration of each stops = 90/5 = 18 min

**∴**** Required answer is 18 minutes **

questions.question: The ratio of the incomes of A and B is 7 : 5. A and B save Rs. 4,000 and Rs. 3,500, respectively. If the expenditure of B is half the expenditure of A, then the total income of A and B (in Rs.) will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A saves Rs. 4000

B saves Rs. 3500

**Calculation:**

Let income of A and B be 7x and 5x

Let expense of A be 2y

Expenditure of B = y

According to the question

7x – 2y = 4000 ---- (1)

5x – y = 3500 ---- (2)

Multiply by 2 in equation (2)

10x – 2y = 7000 ---- (3)

Subtract equation (1) from (3)

⇒ x = 1000

Total income of A and B = 7x + 5x = 12x = 12 × 1000 = 12000

**∴**** Total income of A and B is Rs. 12000**

questions.question: If 9x² - 6x + 1 = 0, then the value of 27x³ + (27x³)⁻¹ will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

9x² - 6x + 1 = 0

**Concept used: **

(a)³ + (1/a)³ = (a + 1/a)³ - 3(a + 1/a)

**Calculation:**

9x² - 6x + 1 = 0

⇒ 9x - 6 + 1/x = 0 [Multiplied with1/x]

⇒ 9x + 1/x = 6

⇒ 3x + 1/3x = 2 [Multiplied with1/3]

⇒ (3x)³ + (1/3x)³ = 8 – 3 × 2

⇒ 27x³ + 1/27x³ = 2

⇒ 27x³ + (27x³)⁻¹ = 2

&
lt;strong>∴** Required answer is 2**

questions.question: The average of eighteen numbers is 42. The average of the last ten numbers is 40 and that of the first five numbers is 44. The seventh number is 6 less than the sixth and 7 less that the eight number. The average of the sixth and the eight number is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Average of 18 numbers = 42

Average of last 10 = 40

Average of first 5 = 44

**Concept used:**

Average = Sum of elements/Number of elements

**Calculation:**

Total of 18 numbers = 18 × 42 = 756

Total of last 10 numbers = 40 × 10 = 400

questions.question: The income of A is 40% less than of B. If A gets 25% rise in his income B gets 40% rise in his income, then the percentage increase (correct to two decimal places) in the combined incomes of A and B will be:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

A's income is 40% less than B

**Calculation:**

Let the income of B be Rs. 100

Then, income of A = 40% less than B = 60

A's new income = 75

B’s new income = 140

Total of New income = 140 + 75 = 215

Original income = 100 + 60 = 160

increase in income = 215 - 160 = 55

% increase in income = 55/160

⇒ 34.38% (Approx)

**∴ Required answer is 34.38%**

questions.question: From a rectangular sheet of dimensions 32 cm × 18 cm, a square of side 3 cm is cut from the four corners of the sheet and a box is made. The volume of the box is:
questions.solution:
**Given:**

Dimensions of rectangular sheet = 32 cm × 18 cm.

**Concept used:**

Volume of a cuboid = l × b × h

**Calculation:**

If square of side 3 cm is cut off from corners.

Height of box = 3 cm

Length of box = 32 – 6 = 26 cm

Breadth of box = 18 – 6 = 12 cm

So volume of the box = 936 cm³

**∴ The volume of the box is 936 cm³**
